text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hassan exhorts those elected by the people to devise social and educational programmes which would enable a better approach to solve the problems of young people.
- Agency for the development of northern provinces sets up dialogue and partnership council including ambassadors of the European Union countries.
- Casablanca police arrest people selling cocaine following seizure of six tonnes of cocaine which washed up on Morocco's Atlantic shores.
- National Commission in charge of following up elections examines appeals of some candidates against results of local council polls.

- Morocco dismisses accusations made in foreign radio report that Moroccan mercenaries took part in fighting in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The foreign ministry said it "denies any kind of involvement" in the internal struggle in Brazzaville.
